intro: Zuri Circle helps women build income and savings so they can act on care advice and support their families.

resources.title: 90-day execution track
resources.summary: A structured 90-day programme with weekly goals, peer accountability and coaching to grow your business and prepare for capital.

resources.title: Build a health emergency fund
resources.summary: Set aside a small amount every week for transport and care costs at delivery. A savings group can help you stay consistent.

resources.title: Keep simple business records
resources.summary: Write down what you sell and spend each day. Clear records help you see profit and qualify for loans or grants.

resources.title: Join a peer circle
resources.summary: Meet other women operators to share progress, solve problems and keep each other accountable.
